name: Davco® Superfine White Grout
tagline: A BRIGHT WHITE SMOOTH FINISH CEMENT BASED GROUT
summary: Davco® Superfine White Grout is an bright white, unsanded, Sanitized®, smooth finish cement based grout resistant to a broad spectrum of moulds and bacteria. Davco® Superfine White Grout is suitable for wall applications internally for joints from 1 - 3mm.
metaDescription: Davco® Superfine White Grout is an bright white, unsanded, Sanitized<sup>®</sup>, smooth finish cement based grout resistant to a broad spectrum of moulds and bacteria. Davco® Superfine White Grout is suitable for wall applications internally for joints from 1 - 3mm.
usage: Davco® Superfine White Grout is suitable for most types of tiles and natural stone. Davco® Superfine White Grout is suitable for both commercial and domestic wall applications including shower, bathroom and laundry walls where a bright white wall grout is required.

items.label: Shelf life
items.text:
Plastic film bags: if unopened grout shall remain usable for up to 18 months from date of manufacture.
Paper bags: if unopened grout shall remain usable for up to 12 months from date of manufacture.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store grout in an elevated location, in dry cool conditions out of direct sunlight.

items.label: Consumption
items.text:
Quantity of grout required kg/m2
Tile Size | 1.5mm Joint | 3mm Joint
10x50x6mm | 0.8kg | 1.6kg
150x150x6mm | 0.3kg | 0.6kg
200x100x6mm | 0.3kg | 0.6kg
200x200x6mm | 0.2kg | 0.4kg
300x600x9mm | 0.13kg | 0.25kg
The coverage of the grout will vary depending upon the texture, size and thickness of the tile and the width of the grout joint. Use the table as a general guide only.

items.label: EQUIPMENT
items.text:
Tools required;
Mixing buckets & clean water
Drill with mixing paddle
Grout float / rubber squeegee
Sponge & dry cloth
Personal protective equipment

items.label: SURFACE PREPARATION
items.text:
Before commencing grouting, ensure the tile adhesive has set firmly. This usually requires 24 hours with the majority of tile adhesives depend on application conditions.
Remove any spacer lugs, rake-out any excess adhesive and any loose or foreign material from the grout joints.
In general, ensure the grout joints are clean and dry.

items.label: MIXING
items.text:
The mixing ratio is 20kg of powder to 5.5-6L of potable water.
Add the water to a bucket, then slowly add the Davco Sanitized® Superfine White Grout powder to the water. Stir the mix until a lump-free toothpaste consistency is achieved.
Allow the mix to stand for 5 minutes, re-stir, then use the grout.
Note: Where movement is expected, or for superior performance in general applications, use Davco 4 in 1 Grout Additive instead of water alone. Refer to the Davco 4 in 1 additive data sheet for additional information.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text:
Prior to grouting it is advisable to lightly dampen the grout joints, particularly with porous tiles or in hot conditions.
Using a rubber float or squeegee, work the grout into the joints in a diagonal motion. Make sure the grout is worked into the joint (it should not bridge the joint).
Using a diagonal motion remove excess grout from the surface of the tiles with a rubber float or squeegee.
Clean up the remainder of the grout with a lightly dampened sponge. Regularly rinse the sponge out to help with cleaning and don’t make it too wet.
Leave the grout to cure for 24 hours before cleaning the haze off with a dry cloth.

items.label: CLEANING OF TOOLS
items.text: Tools and surrounding areas should be cleaned up with water while grout is still soft and wet

items.label: CLEANING
items.text: Davco® Superfine White Grout shall require routine maintenance and cleaning with a neutral detergent and water.
